purpose: Deterministic read-only per-app audit bundle containing bounded Defence identity, deployment, workflow, human-review and integrity evidence.
rules: Exports are generated only for canonically reviewed apps.
The export uses a caller-supplied asOf timestamp so repeated generation over unchanged state is deterministic.
Certification identity comes from the reviewed ecosystem ledger.
Current operational state comes from Command Centre at the same asOf timestamp.
Human review, event ledger and checkpoint data are included only when bound to the current observed release review identity.
Event-ledger hash chains and checkpoint stores are verified before their verification results are included.
No raw GitHub patches, source-file contents, environment variables, credentials, tokens, Vault material or arbitrary filesystem files are exported.
Review notes/summaries are bounded workspace metadata already governed by Human Diff Review secret-like-content checks.
The bundle contains no executable next-action invocation; next action is descriptive metadata only.
The exporter mutates nothing and grants no review, candidate, checklist, deployment or certification authority.
nonClaims: An audit export is a snapshot of recorded Defence state at asOf, not an external attestation.
Checkpoint verification proves recorded integrity consistency, not correctness of human judgement.
Absence of human review material means no bound current review material was recorded, not that no human ever examined the code.
